topic_ko: 간과되는 조직 내 배제와 그 악순환
_note: 원문 유형은 문장 삽입. insert를 가장 강하게 구성하고, 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다.

passage: Organizational psychologists have paid little attention to exclusion at work.
Because the problem goes unnoticed, firms rarely put safeguards in place.
Employees who feel shut out try to defend the basic needs that are under threat.
Prosocial behavior helps, since it builds a sense of belonging and self-respect.
Those who manage to adopt such behavior are less likely to be excluded.
Workers who cannot fit into the group, by contrast, meet with even more exclusion.
As they withdraw from conversation and shared activity, their contribution shrinks.
Left unchecked, the cycle deepens and drags down the employee's performance.
choices: why organizational psychologists prefer studying leadership to studying teams
how prosocial behavior can replace formal training programs at work
how overlooked workplace exclusion deepens and harms employee performance
why employees change jobs more often than they did a generation ago
how companies measure the productivity of individual departments
theme.explanation_ko: 간과된 조직 내 배제가 악순환을 거쳐 성과를 해친다는 내용. ③이 주제.
theme.distractor_ko: ①연구 선호, ②교육 대체, ④이직률, ⑤생산성 측정은 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should treat workplace exclusion as a management problem, not a private misfortune.
Organizational psychologists have largely passed over the subject.
As a result, few firms take precautions against it.
Employees who are shut out struggle to protect their threatened basic needs.
Prosocial behavior must be encouraged, for it builds belonging and self-respect.
Workers who cannot fit in, however, face still greater exclusion.
Once they withdraw from communication, their contribution falls away.
Firms must intervene before that cycle reaches the employee's performance.
choices: 직원의 성과 평가는 개인의 노력만으로 판단해야 한다.
기업은 조직 내 배제를 관리 과제로 삼아 예방책을 마련해야 한다.
조직 심리학 연구는 리더십에 더 집중해야 한다.
배제된 직원은 스스로 집단에 맞추는 법을 배워야 한다.
사회적 활동은 업무 시간 외에만 이루어져야 한다.
claim.explanation_ko: 배제를 관리 과제로 보고 악순환 전에 개입·예방하자는 주장. ②.
claim.distractor_ko: ①개인 책임론, ③연구 방향, ④자기 적응 책임, ⑤활동 시간은 본문 주장이 아니다.

passage: Exclusion at work is a condition that research has tended to overlook.
Where it is overlooked, no precautions are taken against it.
Excluded employees respond by trying to shore up their threatened basic needs.
Positive social behavior builds belonging and self-respect.
Employees who adopt such behavior face less exclusion.
Those who cannot adapt to the group face more of it.
Withdrawal from communication then reduces what they contribute.
The result is deeper exclusion and weaker performance.
choices: 배제는 조직 성과와 무관한 개인의 감정 문제이다.
긍정적인 사회적 행동은 업무 성과를 직접 결정한다.
집단에 적응하지 못한 직원은 스스로 퇴사하게 된다.
간과된 조직 내 배제는 기여와 성과를 떨어뜨리는 악순환을 낳는다.
조직 심리학은 배제 연구에 가장 많은 자원을 투입해 왔다.
gist.explanation_ko: 간과된 배제가 기여 감소와 성과 악화의 악순환으로 이어진다는 것이 요지. ④.
gist.distractor_ko: ①무관론, ②직접 결정론, ③퇴사, ⑤연구 집중은 본문과 어긋난다.

passage: Exclusion is the workplace condition researchers most often walk past.
Because it goes unstudied, it also goes unguarded against.
Shut-out employees try to defend the basic needs that exclusion threatens.
Belonging and self-respect grow out of positive social behavior.
Employees able to adopt that behavior are excluded less often.
Those unable to adapt to the group are excluded more.
Withdrawal follows, and with it a smaller contribution to the organization.
In the end the employee's performance pays the bill.
choices: The Problem Nobody Studies: Exclusion at Work
How to Hire Employees Who Fit In
title.explanation_ko: 아무도 연구하지 않는 문제인 직장 내 배제를 압축한 ①이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ②채용법, ③생산성 측정, ④학계 논쟁, ⑤연구사는 초점이 아니다.

passage: Workplace exclusion rarely reaches the pages of organizational research.
What is not studied is not guarded against either.
Excluded employees try to protect the basic needs that exclusion threatens.
Prosocial behavior can rebuild belonging and self-respect.
Workers who cannot adapt to the group, however, are pushed further out.
They begin to drift from conversation and shared activity.
Each step outward makes the next step easier to take.
By the time performance falls, the spiral is well advanced.
implication.underlined: Each step outward makes the next step easier to take
choices: employees leave the company as soon as they feel excluded
exclusion feeds on itself, so withdrawal accelerates once it begins
colleagues gradually learn to work without any communication
the organization slowly moves its offices to a new location
workers become more skilled the longer they stay isolated
implication.explanation_ko: '바깥으로 내딛는 한 걸음이 다음 걸음을 쉽게 만든다'는 비유는 배제가 스스로를 키워 이탈이 가속된다는 뜻이다. ②.
implication.distractor_ko: ①즉시 퇴사, ③소통 없는 근무, ④사무실 이전, ⑤숙련도 향상은 모두 다르다.

passage: Exclusion is a state that is ignored by organizational psychologists.
Therefore, it is possible that precautions regarding exclusion are not taken.
Individuals react to exclusion by try to strengthen their threatened basic needs.
Positive social behaviors develop belonging and self-respect.
The likelihood that adaptive individuals will experience exclusion decreases.
However, individuals may be faced with more exclusion when they cannot adapt.
When excluded individuals grow away from communication, their contribution may decrease.
Precautions need to be taken regarding organizational exclusion.
grammar._grammar_note: ③ 'by try' 가 비문법. 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 'by trying' 이 옳다.
grammar.explanation_ko: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 ③은 'by trying'이 되어야 한다. ③이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 수동태 is ignored, ② 가주어 it, ④ 단수 주어 The likelihood에 맞춘 decreases, ⑤ 수동 부정사 to be taken은 모두 옳다.

passage: Exclusion is a workplace state that research has largely ignored.
Because of that neglect, precautions against it are often not taken.
Excluded employees try to strengthen the basic needs that exclusion threatens.
Positive social behavior builds belonging and self-respect.
The likelihood of exclusion increases for employees who adapt to such behavior.
Those who cannot adapt to the group meet with more exclusion instead.
Withdrawal from communication then reduces their contribution.
Unchecked, the cycle harms the employee's performance.
vocab._vocab_note: ④ 'increases' 가 의도적 오답. 긍정적 사회 행동에 적응한 직원의 배제 가능성은 '감소해야(decreases)' 뒤 문장의 대조가 성립한다.
vocab.explanation_ko: 긍정적 사회 행동에 적응한 직원은 배제 가능성이 낮아지므로 ④는 decreases가 되어야 하며 increases는 정반대이다. ④가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①간과된 ②위협하다 ③소속감 ⑤기여는 문맥상 모두 적절하다.

passage: Exclusion at work is a condition researchers have mostly left alone.
Where no one studies a problem, no one prepares for it either.
Excluded employees try to defend the basic needs the situation threatens.
Prosocial behavior offers a way back, building belonging and self-respect.
Employees who cannot adapt to the group, however, are pushed further out.
As they withdraw from communication and shared activity, __________ .
Deeper exclusion follows, and the employee's performance suffers with it.
That is why precautions matter so much to a business.
choices: their working hours are formally reduced
what they contribute to the organization shrinks
the company relocates them to another office
blank.explanation_ko: 소통과 활동에서 멀어지면 조직에 대한 기여가 줄어든다는 흐름이고, 뒤 문장의 '성과 악화'와 이어진다. ③.
blank.distractor_ko: ①급여 조정, ②근무시간 단축, ④동료 교육, ⑤사무실 이동은 본문 인과와 무관하다.

irrelevant.intro: Exclusion is a workplace condition that organizational psychologists have largely ignored, so precautions are rarely taken.
sentences: Excluded employees try to strengthen the basic needs that the situation threatens.
Positive social behavior helps by building belonging and self-respect.
Employees who cannot adapt to the group face still more exclusion.
Withdrawal from communication then reduces what they contribute to the organization.
Most office buildings today are designed to make the best use of natural light.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '배제 → 적응 여부 → 위축 → 기여 감소'의 흐름인데 ⑤ '사무실 채광 설계'는 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③④는 모두 조직 내 배제의 전개라는 흐름에 연결된다.

order.given: Exclusion is a workplace condition that organizational psychologists have largely ignored, so precautions against it are often never taken.

blocks.A: Employees who cannot adapt to the group, however, face still more exclusion, and they begin to withdraw from communication and shared activity.
blocks.B: Once that withdrawal sets in, their contribution shrinks, exclusion deepens further, and the employee's performance suffers.
blocks.C: Those who are shut out respond by trying to protect the basic needs under threat, and prosocial behavior helps them rebuild belonging and self-respect.

order.explanation_ko: (C)가 주어진 글의 배제에 대한 개인의 반응을 설명하고, (A)의 however가 적응 실패라는 반대 경우를 제시하며, (B)의 'that withdrawal'이 (A)의 위축을 받는다. (C)-(A)-(B).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 however는 뒤집을 앞 내용이 필요하고, (B)의 'that withdrawal'은 위축이 먼저 언급되어야만 가리킬 대상이 생긴다.

insert.insert_sentence: However, individuals who cannot adapt to the group may find themselves excluded even more.

passage_marked.text: Exclusion is a workplace condition that organizational psychologists have largely ignored.
Because of that neglect, precautions against organizational exclusion are often never taken.
Prosocial behavior builds belonging and self-respect, so employees who adopt it are excluded less often.
Such excluded employees drift away from communication and shared activity, and their contribution to the organization shrinks.
If nothing is done, exclusion deepens further and the employee's performance suffers badly.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 However는 ③ 앞의 '적응하면 배제가 줄어든다'를 뒤집고, 뒤 문장의 'Such excluded employees'가 주어진 문장이 만든 배제된 직원을 받는다. ③이 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ③이 아니면 'Such excluded employees'가 가리킬 대상이 없고, However가 뒤집을 긍정적 결과도 앞에 놓이지 않는다.

passage: Organizational psychologists have paid little attention to workplace exclusion.
Firms therefore take few precautions against it.
Excluded employees try to defend their threatened basic needs.
Prosocial behavior builds belonging and self-respect.
Employees who adopt it are excluded less often.
Employees who cannot adapt to the group are excluded more.
Withdrawal from communication then reduces their contribution.
Deeper exclusion and weaker performance follow.
summary.summary_template: Because workplace exclusion is __(A)__ , it goes unaddressed, and employees who cannot adapt withdraw until their performance __(B)__ .
summary.explanation_ko: 배제가 (A)간과되기(overlooked) 때문에 방치되고, 적응 못 한 직원은 위축되어 성과가 (B)나빠진다(suffers). ③.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 celebrated/measured가 아니라 overlooked, (B)는 improves가 아니라 suffers여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 긍정적인 사회적 행동은 소속감과 자존감을 발달시킨다.
writing.answer: Positive social behaviors develop belonging and self-respect.
writing.explanation_ko: 복수 주어 behaviors에 맞춰 동사 develop, 목적어는 belonging and self-respect.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 개인은 집단에 적응할 수 없을 때 더 많은 배제에 직면할 수도 있다.
writing.answer: Individuals may be faced with more exclusion when they cannot adapt to a group.
writing.explanation_ko: be faced with(~에 직면하다) + when 부사절 + adapt to(~에 적응하다).

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 조직 내 배제에 관한 예방책이 취해질 필요가 있다.
conditions: need to be + 과거분사 형태를 쓸 것
writing.answer: Precautions need to be taken regarding organizational exclusion.
writing.explanation_ko: need to be taken(수동 부정사) + regarding(~에 관하여).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: When excluded individuals grow away from communication, their ___________ to the organization may decrease.
writing.explanation_ko: 조직에 대해 내놓는 몫을 본문은 'contribution(기여)'으로 표현한다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: The likelihood that individuals who try to adapt to positive social behaviors will experience organizational exclusion decreases.
writing.answer: 긍정적인 사회적 행동에 적응하려고 노력하는 개인이 조직 내 배제를 경험할 가능성은 감소한다.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어의 핵은 The likelihood이고 동사는 문장 끝의 decreases. that절은 동격, who절은 individuals를 수식한다.

writing.question: 다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 한 단어를 각각 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Employees who cannot (A)___________ to a group face more exclusion, and as they withdraw their (B)___________ to the organization decreases.
writing.explanation_ko: (A)는 본문의 adapt to a group, (B)는 their contribution to the organization에서 가져온다.
